title: Environmental and economic co-benefits of climate and clean air policies in Korea
abstract: Climate change and air pollution are closely related environmental challenges that share common drivers. Consequently, identifying synergies in policy responses can help governments more effectively tackle these interlinked issues. This paper provides insights on interactions between the two interlinked issues and evaluate the contribution of air quality policies to the net-zero emission transition in Korea. It first explores the landscape of domestic air quality and climate policies. Across four policy scenarios, it subsequently models the integrated environmental and economic benefits of enhanced climate and clean air policy action to 2050.
abstract_zh: 气候变化与空气污染是密切相关的环境挑战，二者具有共同的驱动因素。因此，识别政策应对中的协同效应，有助于政府更有效地应对这些相互关联的问题。本文揭示了这两个相互关联的问题之间的相互作用，并评估了空气质量政策对韩国迈向净零排放转型的贡献。文章首先梳理了国内空气质量政策和气候政策的整体状况。随后，在四种政策情景下，文章模拟了到2050年加强气候和清洁空气政策行动所带来的综合环境与经济效益。

title: Scaled-up crediting approaches to deliver climate change mitigation results: Paying for performance?
abstract: Carbon credit markets are flexible tools that can incentivise greenhouse gas mitigation at different scales. Historically, most carbon credits have been generated at the project level, but crediting approaches at larger scales are emerging. These approaches can operate across entire jurisdictions, sectors or policies, placing governments at the centre of the crediting approach. This enables a wider range of mitigation efforts, including government strategies, policies and enforcement. For scaled-up crediting to effectively support climate change mitigation, approaches must be designed and implemented with a high level of integrity. This paper examines key integrity considerations in scaled-up crediting, with a focus on environmental integrity in jurisdictional forest crediting. The analysis highlights that scaled-up crediting can help address certain integrity risks associated with project-based crediting, but considerable methodological and implementation challenges remain. The paper presents strategic considerations for donor governments to help ensure that scaled-up crediting approaches become more effective tools for climate change mitigation.
abstract_zh: 碳信用市场是可以在不同规模上激励温室气体减排的灵活工具。过去，大多数碳信用是在项目层面产生的，但更大规模的信用机制正在兴起。这些机制可以覆盖整个司法管辖区、行业或政策，使政府处于信用机制的核心位置。这使得更广泛的减排努力得以纳入，包括政府战略、政策和执法。为使规模化信用机制切实支持气候变化减缓，相关机制必须以高度的诚信水平进行设计和实施。本文考察规模化信用中的关键诚信问题，重点关注司法管辖区森林信用中的环境诚信。分析表明，规模化信用有助于应对基于项目的信用机制所伴随的某些诚信风险，但在方法论和实施方面仍存在相当大的挑战。本文为捐助国政府提出战略性考量，以确保规模化信用机制成为更有效的气候变化减缓工具。

title: Exploring governments’ efforts to shape carbon credit markets: Possible actions to enhance integrity
abstract: Carbon credit markets are a tool that can support greenhouse gas mitigation. However, to effectively support climate action, they must operate with environmental integrity. In the last decade, government influence receded in carbon credit markets, but several governments are now exploring how to increase their engagement with such markets. This paper explores governments’ efforts to shape carbon credit markets, with a focus on opportunities to enhance integrity. The paper highlights that governments can play an important role in enhancing environmental integrity, by promoting carbon credit quality improvements and clarifying the conditions under which credits can be used. For instance, governments could support ambitious quality standards or encourage the responsible use of carbon credits. To enhance integrity, governments can leverage new frameworks, notably provisions under Article 6 of the Paris Agreement. Governments can promote harmonisation to prevent integrity framework differences from negatively impacting carbon credit markets.
abstract_zh: 碳信用市场是支持温室气体减排的一种工具。然而，要有效支持气候行动，它们必须以环境诚信运行。在过去十年中，政府在碳信用市场中的影响力有所减弱，但目前一些政府正在探索如何加强其对此类市场的参与。本文探讨政府塑造碳信用市场的努力，重点关注提升诚信的机会。文章指出，政府可以通过推动碳信用质量的改善以及明确信用的使用条件，在增强环境诚信方面发挥重要作用。例如，政府可以支持高标准的质量规范，或鼓励负责任地使用碳信用。为提升诚信，政府可以利用新的框架，尤其是《巴黎协定》第六条的相关规定。政府可以推动协调统一，以防止诚信框架之间的差异对碳信用市场产生负面影响。

title: Fiscal and economic consequences of a net-zero transition in Spain
abstract: To meet the goal of net-zero emissions by 2050, Spain will need to take further climate action in the years ahead. Enhanced policy measures, such as taxes, subsidies and standards, will have implications for the public budget and for the economy. This paper quantifies these implications by comparing two scenarios developed with the ENV-Linkages model: a baseline with current policies, and a net-zero scenario in which more ambitious climate policy measures are implemented to reduce CO2 emissions. The analysis shows that ambitious climate action and economic growth can go hand-in-hand. While the consequences for the public budget will be strongly influenced by the chosen climate policy instruments, the findings illustrate that the changes in net fiscal revenues induced by additional climate policy can be small compared to the overall size of government revenues in 2050.
abstract_zh: 为实现2050年净零排放目标，西班牙在未来几年需要采取更多气候行动。加强型政策措施，如税收、补贴和标准，将对公共预算和经济产生影响。本文利用ENV-Linkages模型比较两种情景，量化这些影响：一是现行政策的基准情景，二是更雄心勃勃的气候政策措施以减少二氧化碳排放的净零情景。分析表明，雄心勃勃的气候行动与经济增长可以齐头并进。尽管公共预算的后果在很大程度上受所选气候政策工具的影响，但研究结果表明，与2050年政府总收入的规模相比，额外气候政策所引起的净财政收入变化可能很小。

title: Public finance resilience in the transition towards carbon neutrality: Modelling policy instruments in a global net-zero emissions
abstract: This paper presents a detailed economic modelling analysis of public finance in the transition towards carbon neutrality. It outlines results from a Net-Zero Emission Ambition scenario, which reflects the ambition to achieve net-zero carbon dioxide emissions globally by mid-century, using a broad and region-specific policy package that combines various policy instruments: carbon pricing, removal of fossil fuel support, regulations in the power sector, and other policies that stimulate investments by firms and households to reduce and decarbonise energy use. The analysis relies on the OECD global computable general equilibrium ENV-Linkages model. Results show that transitioning towards carbon neutrality is feasible when considering economic and fiscal consequences. The scenario achieves carbon neutrality while maintaining continued economic growth, despite a limited negative impact on global GDP and on public revenues. The fiscal effects reflect a trade-off between instruments that increase public revenues (carbon pricing) or reduce public expenditures (fossil fuel subsidies removal), on the one hand, and more costly instruments (subsidies) and indirect effects (tax base erosion and changes in fiscal and economic structure) on the other hand.
abstract_zh: 本文对迈向碳中和过程中的公共财政进行了详细的经济建模分析。文章阐述了“净零排放雄心”情景的结果，该情景反映了到本世纪中叶在全球范围内实现二氧化碳净零排放的雄心，并采用了一套广泛且因地区而异的政策组合，结合了多种政策工具：碳定价、取消化石燃料补贴、电力行业监管，以及其他刺激企业和家庭投资以减少能源使用并实现能源脱碳的政策。分析依托经合组织的全球可计算一般均衡模型ENV-Linkages。结果表明，在兼顾经济和财政后果的情况下，向碳中和转型是可行的。该情景在实现碳中和的同时保持了经济的持续增长，尽管对全球GDP和公共收入的负面影响有限。财政效应体现了一种权衡：一方面是增加公共收入（碳定价）或减少公共支出（取消化石燃料补贴）的工具，另一方面是成本较高的工具（补贴）以及间接效应（税基侵蚀及财政和经济结构变化）。

title: The economic consequences of air pollution policies in Arctic Council countries: A sectoral analysis
abstract: This report quantifies the environmental, health and economic consequences of policy action on air pollution in Arctic Council countries, with a focus on sectoral differences. The report takes a modelling approach and compares a baseline scenario that reflects current legislation, with a policy scenario in which the best available techniques to reduce emissions are deployed in all emitting sectors. The report highlights that benefits from air quality improvements can be obtained when considering emission reductions throughout the economy, and not just in the sectors that are targeted more often, such as industry and transport. The results presented in the report also highlight the need for country-specific policy strategies that take into account the current levels of policy stringency, the sectoral contributions to air pollution, and the need for sectoral investment in new technologies, which also vary by country.
abstract_zh: 本报告量化了北极理事会成员国空气污染政策行动所带来的环境、健康和经济后果，重点关注部门差异。报告采用建模方法，将反映现行立法的基准情景，与在所有排放部门部署现有最佳减排技术的政策情景进行比较。报告指出，只有考虑全经济范围内的减排，而不仅仅是工业和交通等较常被纳入管制的部门，才能获得空气质量改善的效益。报告结果还强调，需要制定因国而异的政策战略，这些战略应考虑当前的政策严格程度水平、各部门对空气污染的贡献，以及各国在新技术方面各不相同的部门投资需求。

title: The economic benefits of international co-operation to improve air quality in Northeast Asia: A focus on Japan, Korea and China
abstract: Air pollution is a global challenge to people’s health and has severe economic consequences. The region of Northeast Asia is no exception. Across most regions in Japan, and in the entire territories of Korea and China, annual average concentrations of fine particulate matter are above the guideline levels indicated by the World Health Organisation, indicating a risk to health. Policy action to tackle air pollution across the three countries, could prevent air pollution related illnesses and deaths, without affecting economic growth. This report presents projections for the impact of air pollution polices until 2050, with differing levels of regional coordination. Projections for current policies are compared with unilateral policy action, whereby each of the three countries introduce more stringent policies to tackle air pollution; alongside regionally coordinated policy action by all three countries; and policy action on a global level. The report presents the health, agricultural and economic impacts, and identifies considerable benefits from further coordination on air pollution policies, such as with regional and global policy action.
abstract_zh: 空气污染是对人类健康的全球性挑战，并造成严重的经济后果。东北亚地区也不例外。在日本的大多数地区，以及韩国和中国的全部国土范围内，细颗粒物的年均浓度都高于世界卫生组织的指导水平，这表明存在健康风险。三国协同开展应对空气污染的政策行动，可以在不影响经济增长的前提下，预防与空气污染相关的疾病和死亡。本报告给出了到2050年空气污染政策影响的预测，并区分了不同程度的区域协调。研究比较了现行政策的预测与单边政策行动（即三国各自实施更严格的空气污染政策）的预测，同时比较了三国进行区域协调行动以及全球层面政策行动的预测。报告展示了健康、农业和经济影响，并指出进一步协调空气污染政策（如区域和全球政策行动）可带来可观的效益。

title: Policy scenarios for a transition to a more resource efficient and circular economy
abstract: Global materials use is expected to grow in the coming decades in the absence of new policies, bearing substantial negative impacts for the environment. This report analyses the mechanisms through which resource efficiency and circular economy policies can achieve a decoupling between economic growth and material use. Using the OECD’s ENV-Linkages model, the report examines the economic and environmental impacts of a global material fiscal reform, which implements taxes on primary metal and mineral resources, and uses the revenue of these taxes to finance subsidies to recycled goods and to secondary metal production.
abstract_zh: 在缺乏新政策的情况下，未来几十年全球材料使用量预计将持续增长，对环境造成严重的负面影响。本报告分析资源效率和循环经济政策能够实现经济增长与材料使用脱钩的机制。报告利用经合组织的ENV-Linkages模型，考察了全球材料财政改革的经济和环境影响。该改革对原生金属和矿产资源征税，并将税收收入用于补贴再生产品和再生金属生产。

title: The long-term implications of the COVID-19 pandemic and recovery measures on environmental pressures: A quantitative exploration
abstract: This paper analyses the long-term effects of the COVID-19 pandemic and associated government responses on the environment. It uses large-scale modelling to investigate the impact of sectoral and regional shocks to the economy until 2040. These detailed economic impacts are linked to a range of environmental pressures, including greenhouse gas emissions, emissions of air pollutants, the use of raw materials and land use change. The short-term reductions in environmental pressures are significant: in 2020, energy-related greenhouse gas and air pollutant emissions dropped by around 7%. Environmental pressures related to agriculture observed a smaller drop in 2020. The reduction in the use of non-metallic minerals, including construction materials, reached double digits. From 2021, emissions are projected to increase again, gradually getting closer to the pre-COVID baseline projection levels as growth rates recover fully. But there is a long-term – potentially permanent – downward impact on the levels of environmental pressures of 1‑3%.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了新冠疫情及政府相关应对措施对环境的长期影响。文章利用大规模建模，考察了直至2040年经济中行业和地区冲击的影响。这些详细的经济影响与一系列环境压力相联系，包括温室气体排放、大气污染物排放、原材料使用和土地利用变化。短期内环境压力的减少十分显著：2020年，能源相关的温室气体和大气污染物排放量下降了约7%。农业相关的环境压力下降幅度较小。非金属矿物（包括建筑材料）的使用量减少幅度达到两位数。从2021年起，排放量预计将再次上升，并随着经济增长完全恢复而逐渐接近疫情前的基准预测水平。但存在一种长期的、可能是永久性的下行影响，使环境压力水平下降1%至3%。

title: Capturing Key Energy and Emission Trends in CGE models: Assessment of Status and Remaining Challenges
abstract: Limiting global warming in line with the goals in the Paris Agreement will require substantial technological and behavioural transformations. This challenge drives many of the current modelling trends. This paper undertakes a review of 17 state-of-the-art recursive-dynamic computable general equilibrium (CGE) models and assesses the key methodologies and applied modules they use for representing sectoral energy and emission characteristics and dynamics. The purpose is to provide technical insight into recent advances in the modelling of current and future energy and abatement technologies and how they can be used to make baseline projections and scenarios 20-80 years ahead. In order to represent likely energy system transitions in the decades to come, modern CGE tools have learned from bottom-up studies. We distinguish between three different approaches to baseline quantification: (a) exploiting bottom-up model characteristics to endogenize responses of technology investment and utilization, (b) relying on external information sources to feed the exogenous parameters and variables of the model, and (c) linking the model with more technology-rich, partial models to obtain bottom-up- and pathway-consistent parameters.
abstract_zh: 要实现《巴黎协定》设定的限制全球变暖目标，需要大规模的技术和行为转型。这一挑战推动了当前许多建模趋势的发展。本文回顾了17个最新的递归动态可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型，评估了这些模型用于表征部门能源和排放特征及动态的关键方法和应用模块。目的在于为最新进展提供技术层面的洞见，即如何对当前和未来的能源与减排技术进行建模，以及如何利用这些模型做出未来20至80年的基准预测和情景分析。为了描绘未来几十年可能出现的能源系统转型，现代CGE工具已借鉴了自下而上研究的经验。我们区分了基准量化的三种不同方法：（a）利用自下而上模型的特征，将技术投资和利用的响应内生化；（b）依赖外部信息来源，为模型的外生参数和变量提供数据；（c）将模型与技术细节更丰富的局部模型相连接，以获得与自下而上方法和路径一致的参数。

title: Approaches and issues in valuing the costs of inaction of air pollution on human health
An Overview of the OECD ENV-Linkages Model: Version 3
Consequences of Climate Change Damages for Economic Growth: A Dynamic Quantitative Assessment
abstract: This report focuses on the effects of climate change impacts on economic growth. Simulations with the OECD’s dynamic global general equilibrium model ENV-Linkages assess the consequences of a selected number of climate change impacts in the various world regions at the macroeconomic and sectoral level. This is complemented with an assessment of very long-run implications, using the AD-RICE model. The analysis finds that the effect of climate change impacts on annual global GDP is projected to increase over time, leading to a global GDP loss of 0.7% to 2.5% by 2060 for the most likely equilibrium climate sensitivity range. Underlying these annual global GDP losses are much larger sectoral and regional variations. Agricultural impacts dominate in most regions, while damages from sea level rise gradually become more important. Negative economic consequences are especially large in South and South-East Asia whereas other regions will be less affected and, in some cases, benefit thanks to adjustments from international trade. Emissions to 2060 will have important consequences in later decades and centuries. Simulations with the AD-RICE model suggest that if emissions continue to grow after 2060, annual damages of climate change could reach 1.5%-4.8% of GDP by the end of the century. Some impacts and risks from climate change have not been quantified in this study, including extreme weather events, water stress and large-scale disruptions. These will potentially have large economic consequences, and on balance the costs of inaction presented here likely underestimate the full costs of climate change impacts. More research is needed to assess them as well as the various uncertainties and risks involved. However, this should not delay policy action, but rather induce policy frameworks that are able to deal with new information and with the fact that by their nature some uncertainties and risks will never be resolved.
abstract_zh: 本报告关注气候变化影响对经济增长的后果。利用经合组织的动态全球一般均衡模型ENV-Linkages进行的模拟，评估了若干选定的气候变化影响在世界各地区的宏观经济和部门层面的后果。此外，还利用AD-RICE模型进行了超长期影响评估。分析发现，在最可能的平衡气候敏感度范围内，气候变化影响对全球年度GDP的效应预计将随时间增大，到2060年全球GDP损失为0.7%至2.5%。在这些全球年度GDP损失背后，存在更大的部门和地区差异。农业影响在大多数地区占主导地位，而海平面上升造成的损害则逐渐变得更加重要。南亚和东南亚的负面经济后果尤为严重，而其他地区受影响较小，有些地区甚至会因国际贸易带来的调整而受益。2060年之前的排放将在之后的数十年乃至数百年产生重要后果。AD-RICE模型的模拟表明，如果2060年后排放继续增长，到本世纪末气候变化造成的年度损害可能达到GDP的1.5%至4.8%。一些气候变化的影响和风险在本研究中未被量化，包括极端天气事件、水资源压力以及大规模的系统性中断。这些因素可能产生巨大的经济后果，总体而言，本文所呈现的不作为成本很可能低估了气候变化影响的全部代价。需要开展更多研究来评估这些影响，以及各种不确定性和风险。然而，这不应延误政策行动，而应促使建立能够应对新信息的政策框架，因为从本质上讲，某些不确定性和风险将永远无法消除。

Addressing Competitiveness and Carbon Leakage Impacts Arising from Multiple Carbon Markets: A Modelling Assessment
abstract: Competitiveness and carbon leakage issues have been some of the main concerns in the implementation and discussions of climate policies. These concerns are particularly important in the presence of multiple carbon markets since differences in climate change policy approaches may have impacts on the relative competitiveness of domestic sectors in countries with more stringent policies, and on the environmental effectiveness through carbon leakage. This paper examines the macroeconomic and sectoral competitiveness and carbon leakage impacts associated with a range of stylised mitigation policy scenarios. The scenarios reflect different depictions of carbon markets in terms of their level of linkages, their coverage (i.e. number of countries participating, types of gases and sectors) and the stringency of the carbon pricing policy across countries. The paper also investigates some policies to address competitiveness and carbon leakage issues. The analysis considers border carbon adjustments (BCAs) as well as direct and indirect (offset-based) linking of carbon markets. The results show that in presence of multiple carbon markets, competitiveness can decrease in countries that undertake climate policies, also leading to carbon leakage. The negative sectoral competitiveness and leakage effects can be reduced when more countries act, more emission sources are covered, and when the climate mitigation policy is harmonised across countries. The results also show that response policies, such as BCAs and linking of carbon markets, can address some, but not all, of the competitiveness and carbon leakage issues. While BCAs are more effective in addressing domestic competitiveness concerns than linking instruments, the latter are better in preserving the welfare of countries that are not undertaking a climate policy.
abstract_zh: 竞争力和碳泄漏问题一直是气候政策实施和讨论中的主要关切之一。在存在多个碳市场的情况下，这些关切尤为重要，因为各国气候政策路径的差异可能影响政策更严格国家国内行业的相对竞争力，并通过碳泄漏影响环境效果。本文考察了一系列稳健的减缓政策情景下的宏观经济和部门竞争力及碳泄漏影响。这些情景体现了碳市场在以下方面的不同设定：市场之间的联系程度、覆盖范围（即参与国家数量、气体种类和部门），以及各国碳定价政策的严格程度。本文还考察了应对竞争力和碳泄漏问题的若干政策。分析考虑了边境碳调整（BCA）以及碳市场的直接链接和间接（基于抵消的）链接。结果表明，在存在多个碳市场的情况下，实施气候政策的国家的竞争力可能下降，并导致碳泄漏。当更多国家采取行动、覆盖更多排放源以及各国气候减缓政策趋于统一时，部门竞争力和泄漏的负面影响可以减轻。结果还表明，边境碳调整和碳市场链接等应对政策可以解决部分（但并非全部）竞争力和碳泄漏问题。尽管边境碳调整在解决国内竞争力问题上比链接工具更有效，但链接工具在维护未实施气候政策国家的福利方面表现更好。

title: Alternative approaches for levelling carbon prices in a world with fragmented carbon markets

Adapting to Climate Change: Costs, Benefits, and Modelling Approaches
venue: International Review of Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract:
This paper provides a summary and a critical survey of the methodologies and results of the literature on the economics of adaptation. We divide the literature into two broad areas of research. First, we examine the studies that analyse adaptation from a bottom-up perspective. Second, we introduce the studies that examine adaptation using a top-down approach. The first group of studies investigates cost and benefits of adaptation at the sectoral, regional and global level. The second group includes theoretical literature on the relationship between mitigation and adaptation as well as emerging insights from some global Integrated Assessment Models (IAMs), which have recently been extended to include adaptation as an alternative and complementary policy option to mitigation.
This latter development has raised issues that represent new challenges for the research community. In particular, understanding how to integrate the vast amount of information provided by the bottom-up literature on climate change impacts and adaptation into global models is paramount. Another challenge is to improve the sectoral and regional coverage of information on adaptation costs and benefits. Currently, much of the information is limited to specific sectors and drawn primarily from developed country contexts. In addition, uncertainty and irreversibility are very marginally tackled by adaptation studies. Finally, the role of adaptation in international climate change negotiations, which is presently growing in importance, remains largely unexplored.
abstract_zh:
本文对气候变化适应经济学文献的方法和结果进行了综述和批判性评述。我们将文献分为两大研究领域。首先，我们考察从自下而上视角分析适应问题的研究。其次，我们介绍采用自上而下方法考察适应问题的研究。第一类研究考察了部门、区域和全球层面的适应成本与收益。第二类包括关于减缓与适应之间关系的理论文献，以及一些全球综合评估模型（IAMs）中新出现的洞见，这些模型近来已被扩展，将适应作为减缓的一种替代性和补充性政策选项。
这一最新进展提出了研究界面临的新挑战。特别是，如何将自下而上文献所提供的关于气候变化影响和适应的大量信息整合进全球模型，至关重要。另一项挑战是提升适应成本与收益信息的部门和区域覆盖范围。目前，大部分信息仅限于特定部门，且主要来自发达国家的情境。此外，适应研究对不确定性和不可逆性的处理非常有限。最后，适应在国际气候变化谈判中的作用日益重要，但目前仍基本未被探索。
